svg.title: E2B Embed layer map
svg.desc: Four bands, top to bottom: source files in the repo, the Dockerfiles that copy them, the thirteen images (three built here, ten pulled), and the twenty compose services with the depends_on gates drawn (the seed → base-template, preflight → api-secrets and dashboard → ready gates are omitted for space). The stripe on each service names its image.
svg.text: docker-bake.hcl builds all three: make images locally under the pinned names, and the maintainers publish those same images
4 · Services in compose.yaml · arrows are depends_on gates · the stripe says which image
:3001 · signs in with the team key
ready and smoke wait on the same two gates, client-proxy healthy and base-template done (ready also waits for the dashboard); the crossing arrows are those gates, not a link between the two services
